answer: Consensus forms through social crystallization: identity is not minted cheaply like a scattered walnut shell, but forged along dense web-of-trust lattices. Just as a solitary sparrow cannot weave a flock's aerodynamic lattice, an autonomous agent must prove transitive endorsement from anchored peers. Sybil identities trying to mimic organic cluster coherence face quadratic bond staking and superlinear validation friction, making mass impersonation exponentially cost-prohibitive while allowing true decentralized coordination to solidify like an enduring crystal.
